title: AkcliDesignIntent
description: Design document for `akcli ops from-intent`: the pin->net table (exactly the `check --intent` nets format) plus the component declarations and layout hints the generator needs. A file of this shape is a SUPERSET of the intent-assertion format, so the same document that generated a sheet remains the assertion baseline for `akcli check --intent`.

mode.description: Document-level assertion mode for `check --intent` (generation ignores it).

nets.description: Net name -> members, exactly the `check --intent` format. For GENERATION every member must be a literal 'REF.PIN' with the pin addressed by NUMBER; wildcard members and bus-vector net names (NAME[a..b], group {..} notation) are refused with DESIGN_UNSUPPORTED.

components.description: REF -> component declaration. Required for every REF appearing in `nets`; a declared component no net references is still placed, with every pin no-connected.

lib_id.description: Symbol to place (e.g. 'Device:R'); resolved through the same --symbols / config [paths] / lib-table chain as plan/draw.

layout.description: Optional grid-layout hints; every key has a sane default. The generator owns all geometry: components go into a uniform grid of cells sized to fit the largest body + pin field + estimated label text.

origin.description: [x_mil, y_mil] top-left of the placement grid (default [1000, 1000]); snapped to the 50-mil writer grid. With `group` set it becomes the group origin and op coordinates are group-local.

columns.description: Grid columns (default: ceil(sqrt(placement count)) for a roughly square block).

margin_mil.description: Extra clearance added around every cell's content, in mils (default 100).

group.description: Functional-group name: every emitted op carries this `group` tag and the op-list envelope declares the group with `origin` (see the ops schema).

no_connect_unlisted.description: Emit an add_no_connect for every pin of a placed component that no net lists (default true).
